summary: Full end-to-end testing of ShiftLogistics booking MVP. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed (vehicles, autocomplete via OSM fallback, distance-km, booking creation with server-side fare recalc, list bookings excluding _id, invalid vehicle rejection). Frontend: All 13 required flows pass — vehicle selector (3 cards + selection changes RATE row & shows black active background), pickup/dropoff autocomplete via OSM Nominatim, distance & fare auto-calculation, BOOK NOW button gated by canBook, booking form validation (empty name + short phone errors shown), successful booking submission with success modal + booking ID, and NEW BOOKING resets state.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' Non-blocking but recommended to migrate.

action_items: Optional: replace TouchableWithoutFeedback in BookingFormModal with Pressable to eliminate deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly recalculates fare server-side (ignores client-supplied fare) — good security practice.
MongoDB _id properly excluded via projection in GET /api/bookings.
OSM fallback works reliably; Google Places gracefully skipped when APIs disabled.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly; no hardcoded URLs.
All interactive elements have testID coverage.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ booking via API test (persisted in bookings collection).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses OSM Nominatim fallback (Google Maps API key present but APIs not enabled — intended). Use real Indian city queries like 'connaught place delhi', 'india gate delhi', 'mumbai central' for autocomplete tests. Nominatim returns exactly the queries above; distance between Connaught Place and India Gate ~2.28 KM via Haversine.
